purpose: The repository's instructions for whoever works on the code (Claude): goals, architecture rules, the golden rules, testing, how to work with the father, release procedure, handbook rules and where plans live.
details: Dutch. Checked in and loaded automatically at the start of every Claude session. Short on purpose (details moved to docs/architectuur.md on 16/11/2026). Key rules: the father decides everything the child or parent sees; propose first, build after agreement; big changes get an inventory and phased plan with a stop per phase; evidence before 'done' (full suite, tmux 80×24, comparison on a copy of the data); work files in werk/ before building; no merging, tagging or releasing by Claude; Claude answers the father in English but program and docs are Flemish Dutch. Contains one line pointing to the map in 'leeravontuur structuur/'.
summary: Project rules: the two goals; the layer diagram (curriculum, terminal, venster, kern, inhoud) and five golden rules; always-rules (no curses in kern, colours via theme roles with symbols, click zones for every control, fixed work method, exact arithmetic with Decimal/Fraction, storage only through opslag, every exercise through a Sessie); menus come from the curriculum, max 10 per menu; platforms and start files; testing with NepScherm and tmux; working agreements with the father; release procedure; handbook project rules; and the plan documents.
